optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Web Frontend Engineer, Developer Tools Platform

professionalSummary.text: Developed and maintained pipeline and artifact views for the internal developer console using TypeScript and React, including implementing a virtualized log viewer that improved load performance.
professionalSummary.witness: Developed and maintained the pipeline and artifact views of the internal developer console (TypeScript, React), including the virtualised log viewer that replaced the full-page log render. candidate said the virtualised log viewer 'made the pipeline page load about 3x faster'; asked where the figure came from, he said it was from testing on his own laptop and that he had not looked at the platform's performance dashboard.

experienceHighlights.text: Owned component and end-to-end test suites (React Testing Library and Playwright), adding a smoke run to the pipeline that blocks releases on test failures.
experienceHighlights.witness: Owned the component test suite (React Testing Library) and the end-to-end suite (Playwright) for the console, adding a smoke run to the pipeline that blocks releases on failures.

experienceHighlights.text: Coordinated API changes with backend team through API design reviews, with backend lead approving endpoint changes and adapting console views accordingly.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated API changes with the platform backend team through the API design review; the backend lead approved endpoint changes and I adapted the console views.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented known limitations and hand-over conditions in release notes for each console release, including the artifact view pagination limitation for repositories with over 10k artifacts.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the release notes for each console release, including the known limitation that the artifact view did not paginate repositories with more than ten thousand artifacts, and the hand-over notes for the on-call frontend engineer.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Playwright end-to-end suite for pipeline view and release notes for one console release, with CI pipeline run identifiers as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the Playwright end-to-end suite for the pipeline view and the release notes for one console release, with the CI pipeline run identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: TypeScript, React, React Testing Library, Playwright
skills.witness: Developed and maintained the pipeline and artifact views of the internal developer console (TypeScript, React), including the virtualised log viewer that replaced the full-page log render. Owned the component test suite (React Testing Library) and the end-to-end suite (Playwright) for the console, adding a smoke run to the pipeline that blocks releases on failures.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's work on the pipeline and artifact views, test suite ownership, API coordination, and release documentation. However, the candidate's claim about load time improvement (3x faster) is based on personal laptop testing, not the platform's performance dashboard, and the materials do not confirm a measurable improvement against the published performance baseline.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required due to unsupported claim about load time improvement and missing evidence for requirement req_8b0ecc72a6c9.
